definitions.explanation: Overstepping one's bounds; offering opinions or actions when not appropriate or requested.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{出|で}がましいようです⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: It may be presumptuous of me, but allow me to say one thing.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{出|で}がましい⟦{口出|くちだ}し→口出し：21078_kuchidashi⟧はやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish you would stop your presumptuous interference.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{出|で}がましいこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧すみません。

notes:
FORMS:
{差|さ}し{出|で}る (to put forward) + がましい (seeming like, -ish) → seeming to put oneself forward = presumptuous
- {差|さ}し{出|で}がましい⟦{口出|くちだ}し→口出し：21078_kuchidashi⟧ - presumptuous interference
- {差|さ}し{出|で}がましいようです⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ - it may be presumptuous, but...
- {差|さ}し{出|で}がましさ (noun) - presumptuousness

POLITE USAGE:
「{差|さ}し{出|で}がましいようです⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧…」is a humble way to preface advice or suggestions that one might not have been asked for. It acknowledges that one may be overstepping.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {差|さ}し{出|で}がましい - presumptuous (formal, self-deprecating)
- ⟦お{節介|せっかい}→お節介：07309_osekkai⟧ - meddlesome (more casual, about behavior)
